_comment: Acceptance contract for brain/10-specs/o1-agent-handoff-spike.md. The agent may ONLY flip 'passes'. Entries may never be added, removed, or reworded. Written 2026-09-19.

features.description: A tool running inside agent A's run starts a run on a code-defined Agent B through the same path start_run uses, and B's final output is returned to A as that tool's result.
The same holds when B is a doctype Flow Agent started by name.
When B's run pauses for a write approval, a test records what A's tool receives, A's own run status, the Flow Run row B's pause created and its status.
A test records whether the user invoking A can reach B's paused run through the documented resume path.
A test records which identity B's tools execute under, relative to the user who invoked A.
A test records whether any field on either Flow Run row links A's run to B's run.
brain/40-architecture/agent-handoff-findings.md exists and marks every finding VERIFIED (naming the test method), INFERRED (naming the code read), or UNKNOWN.
A draft ADR exists in brain/20-adr/ with status: proposed, proposing how a specialist's approval request reaches the person talking to the generalist. It is not accepted.
scripts/run-tests.sh prints GATE=GREEN with MIN_TESTS=586, and no engine file outside flow/tests/test_spike_agent_handoff.py is changed.
